# libghostty-vt

Version 1.0.1, official macOS universal static library and C headers from
https://release.files.ghostty.org/libghostty-vt/1.0.1/ghostty-vt-1.0.1.xcframework.zip.
The archive SHA-256 matches the upstream SHA256SUMS. The selected library checksum
is recorded alongside it. No installed Ghostty or Zig toolchain is required.

The MIT library license and the simdutf Apache/MIT notices are included here and
must accompany redistributed Textamp bundles. Headers preserve their upstream
API documentation. The image decoder and terminal surface are provided by the
Textamp host; this static library supplies the VT state machine and render state.
